response: Saved Views is available today for every team on a paid plan. Instead of rebuilding the same filters and sort orders each time you open a project, you can now capture your exact setup — filters, grouping, and sort order — and return to it in one click. Each user can create and save up to 50 views, so you can keep separate setups for sprint planning, bug triage, client reporting, or anything else your workflow needs. Views aren't limited to your own screen, either: share any saved view with your team so everyone works from the same filtered list instead of recreating it from scratch. Shared views update automatically as the underlying data changes, keeping everyone aligned without extra setup. Whether you manage a small team or a large organization, Saved Views helps cut down repetitive clicks and keeps your project boards organized around how your team actually works. It's live now on all paid plans, no upgrade or extra configuration required. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
